CustomField.label: Frozen Columns
CustomField.description: How many columns, counted from the left, stay in place when the grid scrolls sideways: 0 to 5. Blank or 0 freezes none; more than 5 freezes 5.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many columns, from the left, stay in place when the grid scrolls sideways, up to 5. Leave blank for none.
